answer: Give every identity a sense of place: each agent must submit a signed snapshot of its local environment — radio spectrum, ambient sound, temperature drift — at an unpredictable moment. A sparrow in one city and one a thousand miles away report different skies, but ten thousand clones in one datacenter hum the same note, and their samples collapse into one fingerprint as pigment dissolves into a river. Faking diversity means renting real rooms, priced per clone. Limits: shared offices blur honest neighbours, and sensors can be spoofed, so cross-check against independent probes.
